name: 极简留白·禅
description: 极简留白风格，超大行距+轻字重标题+单色调，适合散文、随笔、冥想类文章

styles.h1: font-size: 22px; font-weight: 400; color: #111111; text-align: center; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 16px; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: 2px;
styles.h2: font-size: 20px; font-weight: 400; color: #111111; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 24px; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: 1px;
styles.h3: font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; color: #222222; margin-top: 32px; margin-bottom: 12px; line-height: 1.4;
styles.h4: font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #333333; margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 10px; line-height: 1.4;
styles.h5: font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; color: #555555; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.4;
styles.h6: font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #888888; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.4;
styles.p: font-size: 16px; color: #333333; line-height: 2; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 20px; letter-spacing: 0.3px; text-align: justify;
styles.blockquote: border-left: 1px solid #cccccc; background: #fafafa; margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 24px; border-radius: 0; font-size: 16px; color: #666666; line-height: 1.8; font-style: italic;
styles.blockquote p: font-size: 15px; color: #666666; line-height: 1.8; margin-bottom: 0; font-style: italic; background: transparent;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; border-radius: 4px; display: block; background: #ffffff; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px;
styles.hr: margin-top: 36px; margin-bottom: 36px; height: 1px; background: #eeeeee; border: none;
styles.code: background: #f5f5f5; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 90%; color: #333333; font-family: Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace;
styles.pre: background: #f5f5f5; border-radius: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; overflow: hidden; color: #333333; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word; word-break: break-all;
styles.pre::before: display: flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; background: #eeeeee;
styles.pre code: background: none; color: #333333; font-size: 14px; font-family: Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: separate; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px; font-size: 14px; border-spacing: 0; border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #eeeeee;
styles.th: background: #fafafa; border: 1px solid #eeeeee; text-align: left; font-weight: 500; color: #555555;
styles.ol li::marker: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 22px; height: 22px; min-width: 22px; background: #f5f5f5; color: #555555; border-radius: 50%; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; margin-right: 10px; margin-top: 4px;
styles.li: font-size: 17px; color: #333333; line-height: 2.2; letter-spacing: 0.3px; display: flex; margin-bottom: 10px; align-items: flex-start;
styles.footnotes li: font-size: 13px; color: #999999; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.6; word-break: break-all;
